body_excerpt:
ASUS has released a security update for the ASUS Router Android App to address a reported vulnerability and recommends updating to the latest app version to ensure optimal protection.
An Improper Export of Android Application Components vulnerability exists in the ASUS Router Android App. This vulnerability may allow a third-party application on the same device to interact with the app improperly and trigger unintended actions.
To protect your devices, ASUS recommends that all users update the ASUS Router Android App to version 1.0.0.9.74 or later.
Users can update the app through Google Play or the relevant official app distribution channel.

CVE-2026-12960
